'''1999 Outer Rim Regionals Aldrin Long LS''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Aldrin Long]]
* '''Event:''' [[1999 Outer Rim Regionals]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HB Long LS 1999 OuterRim.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Aldrin became the first-ever World Championship qualifier from Singapore with his Open Championship victory.
